new_libraries.name: Candle
new_libraries.author: S. Shahriar <hi@shadowshahriar.dev>
new_libraries.sentence: Buttery-smooth, non-blocking LED animations for Arduino.
new_libraries.paragraph: Candle is a lightweight, non-blocking LED animation library for Arduino. Candle makes it easy to create soft breathing effects, pulses, fades, notifications, and expressive status animations without blocking your loop().

new_libraries.name: Pulsync
new_libraries.author: Vineeth Rai K <vineethraik@gmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: Non-blocking task scheduler + real-time cloud sync for ESP32.
new_libraries.paragraph: Provides setTimeout, setInterval, and non-blocking equivalents for the ESP32. Includes multi-network WiFi management with a captive portal, real-time cloud communication over MQTT (HTTP for enrollment and OTA), OTA firmware updates with rollback, and remote config. Built for the ESP32; works on both the Arduino and ESP-IDF frameworks.

library.name: LagariMotors
library.author: LAGARI A <lagariscience@gmail.com>
library.sentence: Internal beta - UDP command system for integrated servo/stepper drives (Modbus-RTU / RS-485) on Controllino.
library.paragraph: Hardened Modbus-RTU transport (CRC-verified responses, exception detection, retries, real timeouts), unit-correct motor control (position, velocity, homing, zero/position redefinition), a non-blocking status monitor that pushes limit-switch, fault and online/offline events over UDP, and a full command set (P, PA, S, SD, B, L, BS, Z, ZO, ZS, R, I, X plus V/VA/VS/HV/H extensions). Internal test build - not the final public release.

library.name: SNMP Manager
library.author: Martin Rowan <martin@martinrowan.co.uk>
library.sentence: An SNMP Manager library to make SNMP requests to other SNMP enabled devices.
library.paragraph: Supporting SNMP v1 and v2, SNMP requests can be sent (GetRequest) and their responses received (GetResponse) for various SNMP data types.
